word-town-hall.t: The wedding will be at {city hall} on Saturday.
You can get the form at {city hall}.
The mayor works in the {town hall}.

word-fire-station.t: The {fire station} is next to the school.
The children visited the {fire station} on Friday.
There is a new {fire station} in our town.

word-mosque.t: They go to the {mosque} every Friday.
The {mosque} has a beautiful blue dome.

word-synagogue.t: The {synagogue} is on the corner of Main Street.
His family goes to the {synagogue} on Saturdays.

word-cathedral.t: The {cathedral} is the oldest building in the city.

word-art-gallery.t: We spent the afternoon at the {art gallery}.

Turn left at the end of the {avenue}.
Fifth {Avenue} is a famous street in New York.

word-pedestrian-zone.t: The city center is a {pedestrian zone}.

word-bench.t: Let's sit on that {bench} for a minute.

word-fountain.t: There is a beautiful {fountain} in the main square.

word-opposite.t: The bank is {opposite} the post office.

We walked around the {block} to get some air.

word-tourist-information.t: Let's ask at the {tourist information} for a map.
The {tourist information} is next to the train station.

word-landmark.t: The tower is the most famous {landmark} in the city.

word-outskirts.t: They live on the {outskirts} of the city.
